article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Sebastien Emenalo’s 15 points and eight rebounds off of the bench led Loyola (MD) to a 71-54 victory over Rider on Tuesday. Carter Berg-McLean scored 13 points and added five assists for the Greyhounds (2-5). Robbie Long III shot 5 for 7, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 13 points. Ty Bevins led the way for the Broncs (2-6) with eight points. Bryce Baker added eight points for Rider. Rich Brisco finished with seven points and 12 rebounds. Loyola took the lead about 6 1/2 minutes into the game and did not trail again. Emenalo led the Greyhounds with 13 points in the first half to help put them up 35-23 at the break. Loyola extended its lead to 52-38 during the second half, fueled by a 7-0 scoring run. Long scored a team-high 11 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
